title: Mixing: Front Parlour, Frozen Jap, Summer’s Day Song, Check My Machine by Paul McCartney | 1979
content:
Studio Three, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Eddie Klein

The fifth mixing session for Paul McCartney’s McCartney II album took place on 16 October 1979.

McCartney oversaw stereo mixes of ‘Front Parlour’, ‘Frozen Jap’, ‘Summer’s Day Song’, and ‘Check My Machine’.

The mixes of ‘Frozen Jap’ and ‘Summer’s Day Song’ were used on the the album, but McCartney decided to use the 25 September mix of ‘Front Parlour’ instead of this day’s. He also mixed an unused edit piece titled ‘British Johnnies’ during the session.
